summary.text: Doug Beck is a Democratic member of the Missouri Senate for District 1 in St. Louis County, first elected in 2020, and was chosen Minority Floor Leader in 2024.
His official Senate page says he previously served two terms in the Missouri House of Representatives, from 2016 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Beck has a 39-year career as a pipefitter and member of UA Local 562 and served nine years on the Affton School Board, including two as president.
It says he was born and raised in St. Louis County, graduated from Lindbergh High School in 1983, attended St. Louis Community College, and has been married to his wife, Marilyn, for 41 years.
